sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default value when something is Nothing — combined with the forever combinator that repeats an action indefinitely
The 'never' return type, which indicates a function that never returns — combined with a recursive call that represents an unreachable promise
The 'ensure' block runs whether an exception occurs or not — it is the code that executes regardless of success or failure, the thing that happens no matter what
